decision: GCC/x86 uint32_t only: preserve full-inner accumulator for small B; select Ktile32 and output-row group4 for inner>64 and B.size()>262144. Clang/generic path retained.
ownership: Same std::vector-owned input/result; no extra allocation or auxiliary B packing. First K tile overwrites output, later tiles accumulate. uint32 multiply/add is mod2^32. Public API and exception behavior unchanged.
selection_reason: Full-inner accesses at large row strides caused the original ready prototype to regress on 4096x4096 B. K slices bound active B rows; row groups reuse each B slice before progressing. Row8 only1–2% aggregate improvement in the final run, below control variation, with some 18–38% row1/4 outliers; retain row4.

conditions.cpu: Intel Core i9-14900K, CPU12/Core6 P-core; project compile/test workloads paused; no intentional project load on siblingCPU13; sibling/OS activity not separately instrumented
conditions.main_io: Identical fixture/main across candidates; no I/O speed change. Original six uint32 shapes use8x original loop count, other12 generic shapes unchanged. Stress repeats min(32,max(1,ceil(80M/(M*K*N)))).

metrics.thread_us: CLOCK_THREAD_CPUTIME_ID per product, including result allocation and repeated result assignment; excludes one-time input construction, RNG, checksum and final destruction.
metrics.wall_us: steady_clock per product over same body.
metrics.process_cpu_us: wait4 ru_utime+ru_stime for full child, including startup, input construction/RNG, all products, checksum/output, and final destruction.
metrics.process_wall_us: Parent elapsed from Popen through wait4/pipe collection. Scheduling and launch are included.
metrics.reference: Per condition median5 candidate samples / pooled median10 baseline+same-binary-control samples. Raw baseline/control medians and spread remain in summary.

limitations: One hardware platform. Cutoffs are measured choices, not universal CPU/cache optima.

First two repeats show unexplained wall scheduling/interference: child-wall roughly2x childCPU, later repeats nearly equal. No cause is asserted. All5 randomized repeats retained; whole-wall medians can exceed1 despite large body/childCPU wins.
Fine differences of1–2% are not actionable: stress control median ratios span roughly0.915–1.092 default and0.920–1.084 native; median control IQR around6%, larger outliers occur.

Clang complete .text bytes match baseline in default/native; timing differences there reflect measurement variation. GCC generic products/callees have equal instruction streams after relocation normalization.
Warm repetition is explicit. Earlier one-product screen2 also confirms improvement on the original4096-stride stress; its raw2322 rows remain in temp as preliminary evidence.

validation.portable_arithmetic_fixture: Full uint32 wrap reference; signed16/32 and unsigned16/64 with safe-value arithmetic; threshold/tail/empty/self-alias.
validation.tiled_oracle: Independent uint64 multiply→uint32 reduction, Ktile/tail/row-group boundaries, full threshold shapes, sampled 4096², misaligned direct kernel/canaries/nonzero prior output, self*=self513².
validation.ownership: 24 injected allocation/copy/operation exceptions per setting; normal live_delta0, copy isolation, move-source reuse, align64 and always-on capacity overflow.
validation.fallbacks: Forced GCC runtime-AVX2 availability false executes standard path. Both compilers preprocessed with SIRKIT_DISABLE_SIMD: no dedicated kernel symbols, CPU builtin or AVX2 intrinsic.
validation.fixture_default_include_note: A portable generic oracle was adapted from root-owned CC0 fixture with only default/double include wrapper;20 settings re-run after wrapping. History80 records preserved; final set60 uses all staged fixture hashes.

byte_evidence.handoff: 8 measured→staged loaded-section comparisons (GCC/Clang × default/native ×original/stress) pass byte equality for .text/.rodata/.data/.eh_frame and initialization sections, plus .bss size.
byte_evidence.small_B: Full-inner helper is773bytes, exact same bytes between ready/row4/row8 within each GCC setting. Default and native may differ; comparisons are within setting.
byte_evidence.generic: GCC Field2/VerifyMatrixField product and applicable native operator* instruction streams match after RIP/symbolic branch relocation normalization; Clang whole.text matches baseline.

reproduction.note: Benchmark source text and shared coefficient header are embedded. Original include path can be redirected to the hash-identical repository field; HEADER selects baseline/candidate.
